A really, really old Amiga game called Knights of the Crystallion, the premise was of a tribe that settled amid a leviathan's skeleton and founded a city in its hollow bones. You'd play the leader of a prominent clan who must fulfill their destiny in a quasi-religious rite involving entering the temple-skull of the beast and harnessing the power of fossilized crystals surmized to be remnants of its brain. The aforementioned Crystallion being a magical horse formed out of these.

Basically you had to manage the financial affairs of your clan, while at the same time playing various sub games to increase your psychic and physical powers, as well as the main part of the game which involved navigating a maze in the creatures skull. At the end of each section you would have to win at a board game against a monk to prove your worth.
